finding.comment: The docstring's restart policy cannot be verified from this diff.

input.title: ops: document worker restart policy contract

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/restart.py
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+"""Worker restart metadata.
+
+The restart policy itself, including how failures are counted,
+is defined by the supervisor and is outside this module.
+"""
+
+class RestartPolicy:
+    def __init__(self, max_attempts=3):
+        self.max_attempts = max_attempts

rationale: self-scoped disclaimer; the class carries a default but the docstring asserts no supervisory behavior
